dataset_sha256_method: SHA-256 of sorted compact JSON mapping file names to SHA-256 of original bytes
dataset_sha256_scope: Local inputs. Returned hit titles and texts are checked against the local corpus.

metric_rules.recall_at_3: Macro over positives: relevant IDs in the first 3 hits / all labeled relevant IDs.
metric_rules.mrr_at_3: Macro over positives: reciprocal of the rank of the first relevant hit, or 0.
metric_rules.accuracy: Positives only: all required fact groups match, not refused, and nonempty inline citations match sources in order and cite only labeled relevant hits.
metric_rules.refusal_accuracy: Traps only: refused=true, canonical refusal text (normalized), and no citations.
metric_rules.phrase_matching: Match one contiguous whole-token phrase per group within a clause, ignoring citation markers, case, ё/е and cosmetic punctuation. Decimal commas match points; time colons remain distinct. Reject apparent negation up to four tokens before or immediately after a phrase. This can miss paraphrases, negation and contradictions and does not verify extra claims or which source supports each fact. Review answers manually.
metric_rules.incomplete_run: Any request, generation or response error (or a model change) invalidates aggregate metrics; errors are not refusals.
